title: The park nobody paid for #Shorts
description:
In 1871 a photographer and a painter went to Yellowstone with a government survey. William Henry Jackson developed his glass plates on the spot, and Thomas Moran painted the canyon. Their pictures helped create the first national park.

▶ Full documentary (Part 2, When the Cavalry Guarded the Geysers): https://youtu.be/P99Gu3GCZVw
